Synthetic. A sweep's two listings and a newest check's two are first seen (the handler queues nothing) and then all four are selected by details-selector in one `enqueue()` call, which names no region and asks `new-listing` for all. The queue places each by the search that found it: the newest check's follow-ups go first (`new-listing` before `sweep`), then the older sweep's, one region per batch.
